## Current PM

🟢 `os-tesla` · session `session_01L9qibz8HEj53Wx2uphTo2o` · seated 2026-10-30T14:23:00Z (refreshed 2026-10-31T02:52Z) on the maintainer's summons in the `os-tesla` account's Claude project, seat thread "Take over ui seat 3" (「接管 ui seat 3」). The previous holder's sign-off brief (comment `6524605151`, `os-bill`, `session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe`) and its tail-clear note `6524818411` (stay-behind PR #28126 merged) were the newest events on this post, so the seat was taken at once.

- Posture, round reports and ledger live in that project's seat thread; per-card state lives on each card and PR.
- **Routine:** none (a session-made Routine carries no repo sources). Wake = the maintainer's project thread, the project coordinator, and PR subscriptions.

## Handover ledger

Inherited by pointer: the previous body revision (the `os-bill` tenure, vacant write) and its sign-off brief `6524605151`. Nothing was in flight; #27356 was released to `pm:queue` (`Release:` 6524544915).

## Hot-file serial queue

- **This seat holds (2026-10-31 batch):** #28239 (`claude/project-thread-v8ndrp`), #28240 (`rbfgwx`), #28241 (`hr3zwc`), #28179 (`xe3kz5`), #28164 (`ug538h`); paused #28148 (N-04, `dhj1ou`, holds `views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.tsx` + `packagedFlowLedger.ts`). Shared-file regions: `/mnt/project-files/ui-seat-3/r2026-10-31/FRAME.md`. Landed 2026-10-30: #28193, #28197, #28227, #28254. ⛔ Re-derive from the live `Claim:` comments and each open PR's file list before every dispatch.
- **File area (unchanged from the previous tenure):** Studio — `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/**` and the other Studio views and pages under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/**`, `ui/packages/plugin-designer`, `ui/packages/plugin-editor`, the i18n `studio` namespace; AI chat — `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot`; tooling — `ui/scripts/**`; end-to-end — `ui/e2e/**`. Seats 1 (#25966) and 2 (#25995, reseated 2026-10-31, mailbox #28282) keep their recorded areas; seat 3 also holds #28241 and #28179 from seat 2's area by the 2026-10-31 split (seat 1 mailbox 6537937646). Cards on one file stay with one seat and land in order. Claims carry `Seat: domain:ui#3`.
- **Epic #28236** (package-level override) children carry no `pm:epic` and are claimed by lanes normally.
- **Excluded:** the `pm:epic` subtrees (#8345 multi-currency, #26676 record page). `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` stay ⛔ out of bounds for ui cards.

## Notes

- **Standing constraints (maintainer):** changesets for ui cards go to the root `.changeset/`; no PR on the objectui repository; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is a gate on every ui card. PRs carry no seat-account assignee or review request; a PR that needs the maintainer's approval gets `os-zhuang` requested as reviewer after the seat ACCEPT and a same-head contract PASS. p3 cards may be dispatched (the maintainer lifted the p3 hold, 「可以开p3」). The seat runs contract reviews itself at the contract-review tier (「你有 fable，可以自己契约复审」) and lands PRs it has ACCEPTed under pm-dispatch on its own (「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」); governed Tier H PRs still wait for the human approval.
- **Concurrency:** up to 5 card threads per seat (「每个座位并发可以5」); the maintainer wants them full (「ui 车道一堆任务啊，应该并发开满啊」, 2026-10-31).
- **Mailbox:** #28155 (`pm:mailbox`, subscribed).
- **Publication:** a merge to `main` publishes nothing; the release is the Version Packages PR, a human act.
- **Pointer:** canonical ledger = labels + assignee + `Claim:` comments carrying `Seat: domain:ui#3` + `head:claude/` PRs.
- **Wall:** none.
